svg.title: Vocabulary and application relationship graph: adjacency matrix
svg.desc: Twenty vocabulary terms by six application areas. E is the number of paragraphs explicitly naming a term; I is the number with an implicit annotation. Each cell ranges from zero to two for each frequency. The two frequencies are displayed separately.

g.text: How concepts connect to real applications
Adjacency matrix of the vocabulary → application graph · all connections in one view
Unit: distinct paragraphs per term. Each case contains two paragraphs. Totals across terms can exceed twelve.
Implicit links are curated interpretations with quoted evidence; learner review remains pending. See the HTML inspector.
Source: research.md + graph/terms.json + graph/annotations.json · Research date: 30 October 2026
